name: generate-changeset
description: Creates a Tabler changeset file in `.changeset/` from the current code changes. Use this skill for every changeset in this repo — when the user asks for a changeset, version bump, release note, or changelog entry, and also on your own whenever a change under `core/`, `preview/`, or `docs/` is about to be committed or opened as a PR. Never hand-write the file instead.
